name: Laravel
summary: A PHP application framework centered on an application service container, bootstrapper and service-provider lifecycle, and composable HTTP routing and middleware pipelines.

features.name: Application service container
features.description: Illuminate Foundation Application extends the service Container and registers base bindings, aliases, instances, bindings, and singleton services used by the framework and application.
benefits: Centralizes construction and replacement of application services
costs: Runtime resolution can hide dependencies from static call sites
Binding scope and alias configuration become application-wide behavior

features.name: Service-provider bootstrap lifecycle
features.description: Laravel runs a configured sequence of bootstrappers, registers configured service providers, and then boots providers so framework and application services can be prepared in phases.
benefits: Separates environment loading, configuration, registration, and boot work
Gives packages a standard extension point
costs: Provider ordering and side effects affect startup

features.name: Deferred provider resolution
features.description: The application tracks deferred providers and can register and boot a provider when a deferred service is first resolved rather than eagerly loading every provider at application creation.
benefits: Defers initialization cost for unused services
Lets packages advertise service availability through the container
costs: First resolution may include hidden registration work

features.name: Router and middleware pipeline
features.description: Laravel matches requests to route actions and sends them through a pipeline in which middleware successively transforms or delegates execution to the next stage.
benefits: Composes authentication, authorization, sessions, and other concerns
Keeps routing and request interception explicit

mathematical_views.question: How do service identifiers, bindings, providers, aliases, and resolved instances relate during execution?
assumptions: Abstracts and concrete services are vertices with binding and resolution edges
Singleton edges denote shared lifetime within a container scope

mathematical_views.question: Which transitions take Laravel from construction through environment bootstrap, provider registration, provider boot, and request readiness?
assumptions: Bootstrapper and provider phases are ordered transitions
Deferred services add registration transitions after initial boot
A successful transition does not guarantee a healthy deployment

mathematical_views.question: How does a request pass through ordered middleware before and after a route action?
assumptions: Each middleware is modeled as a function around a downstream continuation
Composition order follows the router pipeline
This is explanatory and does not assert algebraic identity or invertibility

costs: Implicit runtime dependencies hinder local reasoning

benefits: Packages share registration and boot extension points
Unused services avoid some eager work
costs: First-use latency and deferred failures complicate operations

benefits: Cross-cutting behavior composes around route actions
costs: Ordering and stack depth affect performance and semantics
